name: 时间一致性分析
description: 检测视频中帧间不一致性，表明AI生成或篡改。
useCase: 通过时间连贯性分析检测AI生成或篡改的视频
mechanism: Analyzes consecutive video frames for temporal consistency in color, lighting, texture, and object boundaries. AI生成的 videos often exhibit flickering, warping, or sudden changes between frames that natural video does not have.
accuracy: 高 - 82-92%（大多数深度伪造和AI生成视频）
source: Gu et al. (2022) - Exploiting Fine-Grained Face Forgery Clues via Progressive Enhancement Learning, AAAI
algorithm: 帧差分 + 光流一致性 + 时间梯度分析
parameters: 帧采样率: 自适应, 窗口大小: 5-15帧, 指标: MSE, SSIM, 时间梯度方差
strengths:
• 检测深度伪造视频非常有效
• 能识别人眼不可见的细微时间伪影
• 适用于不同视频分辨率
• 补充空间分析方法
limitations:
• 需要视频输入（不适用于图像）
• 对长视频计算密集
• 对高度压缩视频可能产生误报
• 场景切换可能干扰分析

references.title: Gu, Z. et al. (2022). Exploiting Fine-Grained Face Forgery Clues via Progressive Enhancement Learning. AAAI.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
